title: A narrow mountain pass at high altitude, heavy wind and blowing snow…
content: A narrow mountain pass at high altitude, heavy wind and blowing snow, visibility near zero past 40 meters. A column of soldiers advances through the pass on foot. Something colossal moves parallel to them in the fog, felt before it is seen.
